allow: PowerShell($r = try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -TimeoutSec 10 -UseBasicParsing } catch { $_.Exception.Message }; if \($r -is [string]\) { "ERROR: $r" } else { "OK: $\($r.StatusCode\)" })
PowerShell(try { $p = Get-Process -Id 19912 -ErrorAction Stop; "$\($p.Name\) - $\($p.Path\)" } catch { "Process 19912 not found or access denied: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
PowerShell($tcp = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; try { $tcp.Connect\("127.0.0.1", 3000\); "TCP connect OK"; $tcp.Close\(\) } catch { "TCP fail: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($tcp = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $tcp.Connect\("127.0.0.1", 3000\); $stream = $tcp.GetStream\(\); $request = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes\("GET / HTTP/1.0`r`nHost: localhost`r`n`r`n"\); $stream.Write\($request, 0, $request.Length\); $stream.Flush\(\); $buf = New-Object byte[] 4096; $read = $stream.Read\($buf, 0, $buf.Length\); [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString\($buf, 0, $read\); $tcp.Close\(\))
